completion_record.summary: Eight re-review findings across both PRs resolved: two blocking isolation-resolution bugs, the missing brief_chars producer, and four smaller correctness fixes, with 15 new static cases (39-53) and the docs restated to match final behavior.
completion_record.evidence: all six core suites + control add-on green; 52/52 static; npm 34/34; diff-audit blocking [] with empty stderr
completion_record.residual_risk: advisory-only grounding of review independence; see open_risks

minimality_decision.why: The two blocking findings are resolution-logic bugs, fixed inside the existing helpers plus small shape guards. The major finding needed a real producer, so log-delegation is the smallest new command that measures a brief. The three minors are one-call changes (git_capture, index blob spec, cwd + a tag regex).
alternatives_rejected: reuse: no existing command appends a ledger row, so brief_chars had no writer to reuse
existing_dependency: stdlib-only constraint rules out a git library for quiet blob reads

review_findings.finding: _implementer_identity took the first role-matching row across the whole append-only ledger; reviewer resolution likewise, so unrelated historical rows caused false same-family blocks.
review_findings.resolution: Reviewer and implementer are now resolved as a task-scoped pair (evidence task_id, else the record's), with conflicting rows treated as ambiguous -> advisory. Cases 39, 40, 41, 47, 48.

review_findings.finding: Malformed isolation_evidence ({}, blank role, wrong types, missing host) resolved arbitrarily and could BLOCK; an unknown host was treated as 'not different'.
review_findings.resolution: Shape is validated before any lookup, and the block now requires affirmative equality of both recorded hosts AND both model families; unknown stays advisory. Cases 42-46.

review_findings.finding: brief_chars had no producer: the canonical authoring workflow and example omitted it, so the gate fell back to len(brief_summary).
review_findings.resolution: log-delegation ships as the documented writer recording len(full_brief); the workflow, example, control-plane doc, tool contracts and matrix all name it. End-to-end case 49.

review_findings.finding: diff-audit printed raw 'fatal: path ... not in origin/main' for newly added Python files.
review_findings.resolution: _blob_at reads via git_capture; an absent blob is silent. Case 50 asserts empty stderr (red before the fix).

review_findings.finding: --staged complexity read the working tree instead of the index.
review_findings.resolution: Staged mode reads the post-change side from ':path'. Case 51 stages a branchy version behind a reverted working tree (red before the fix).

review_findings.finding: check-version ran git in the caller's cwd and accepted any tag namespace.
review_findings.resolution: The lookup runs with _REPO_ROOT as cwd and filters to ^v?\d+\.\d+\.\d+$. Cases 52 and 53 (both red before the fix).
